title: Learning Graph Energies for Finite-Time Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19946v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Energy-based models can represent distributions over discrete structures such as molecular graphs, but an energy that is accurate at equilibrium need not yield accurate samples when the sampler stops after a fixed number of steps. We introduce finite-horizon energy learning, which adapts the acceptance energy of a Metropolis--Hastings sampler to the distribution it returns after a prescribed number of steps, with initialization, proposals, and annealing schedule held fixed. For graph generation, a frozen pretrained model supplies initialization and proposals, and a learned energy governs acceptance. A training-only discriminator scores completed samples, and coupled continuations of the accepted and rejected branches of a proposal give an acceptance-gradient estimator that is unbiased for a fixed discriminator under stated conditions, without equilibrated negative samples or differentiation through discrete states. translated_title: 面向有限时间生成的图能量学习
translated_abstract: 能量基模型可以表示分子图等离散结构上的分布，但在平衡状态下准确的能量，并不一定能在采样器运行固定步数后停止时产生准确的样本。我们提出了有限时域能量学习（finite-horizon energy learning），它将 Metropolis--Hastings 采样器的接受能量适配到该采样器在规定步数后返回的分布，同时保持初始化、提议分布和退火时间表固定不变。对于图生成任务，一个冻结的预训练模型提供初始化和提议分布，而学习得到的能量控制接受步骤。一个仅在训练阶段使用的判别器对完整样本进行评分，通过对提议的接受分支和拒绝分支进行耦合的延续，可以得到一个接受概率梯度估计器，在所述条件下对于固定的判别器是无偏的，且无需平衡的负样本，也无需对离散状态进行微分。生成过程使用学习到的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“有限时域能量学习”方法，为固定步数后停止的 Metropolis-Hastings 图生成采样器学习接受能量，利用仅训练阶段使用的判别器和接受/拒绝分支的耦合延续获得无偏的接受梯度估计，从而在不依赖平衡负样本或离散状态微分的情况下实现高质量图生成。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces finite-horizon energy learning, which adapts the acceptance energy of a Metropolis-Hastings graph-generation sampler to the distribution it returns after a fixed number of steps, using a training-only discriminator and coupled continuations of accepted and rejected proposal branches to obtain unbiased acceptance-gradient estimates without equilibrated negative samples or differentiation through discrete states.
